title: refactor(ci): reorganize pipeline stages and add dependency telemetry + gatekeeper
author: Priya Menon
description: Motivation: Our CI pipelines have drifted into monolithic workflow files and we lack telemetry on dependency churn. This causes noisy presubmits and slow signal for when dependency upgrades correlate with test regressions. This PR reorganizes CI into modular stage manifests, extracts lint/test runners into language-specific templates, and introduces a lightweight dependency-telemetry exporter and a 'dep-gatekeeper' presubmit that flags high-risk changes. Summary of changes: 1) CI reorg: split the existing .github/workflows/ci.yml into declarative stage manifests under .github/workflows/stages/*. Each stage (setup, lint, unit, integration, release-smoke) can be independently scheduled and cached. 2) Language profiles: introduced ci/profiles/python.yml and ci/profiles/typescript.yml to parameterize lint/test runners and reduce duplication. 3) Dependency telemetry: new job dep-telemetry that runs on dependency-updates and on a daily cadence; it collects changed packages, transitive delta, manifest hashes and uploads a compact event to telemetry.redwood.dev (internal endpoint) for correlation with flaky tests. Telemetry payloads are minimized and GDPR-safe (no file contents, only metadata). 4) Dep gatekeeper: a presubmit step that runs a lightweight static freshness check and flags PRs that update more than N top-level deps or that add dependencies not on the allowlist; it suggests rolling-update steps in the PR body. 5) Release automation: decoupled release hooks from the main pipeline into ci/release/hooks.yml and added a dry-run smoke job to reduce accidental publishes. 6) CI hygiene: consolidated shared actions into ci/actions/ and replaced some ad-hoc bash glue with a small Go-based runner (ci/tools/runner) to be easier to unit test. Checklist: - [x] Split monolithic workflow into stage manifests - [x] Add language-specific lint/test templates - [x] Implement dep-telemetry job and uploader (small Go tool + GH job) - [x] Add dep-gatekeeper presubmit (opt-out via PR label) - [x] Add dry-run release smoke and rollbacks - [x] Update docs: docs/developer/ci.md and docs/ops/dep-telemetry.md Commits (high level): - feat(ci): split ci.yml into stages and add stage orchestration - feat(ci): add python/typescript lint/test profiles and parameterization - feat(deps): add dep-telemetry uploader and event schema - feat(ci): add dep-gatekeeper presubmit job and allowlist - refactor(ci): move shared actions into ci/actions and introduce runner - docs: add developer and ops docs for new workflow Usage and rollout: This is staged: the new staged workflows are enabled but default presubmit routing is backwards-compatible. The dep-gatekeeper is opt-in initially (enabled for redwood/core and redwood/docs by default) and can be disabled with the label 'ci/skip-dep-gate'. We will monitor dep-telemetry for 2 weeks for volume and false positives before widening the gate. Testing performed: - Local unit tests for the Go uploader (ci/tools/runner) - End-to-end smoke on a fork with synthetic dep bumps - Staged rollout to core, docs, and sdk repos - Canary run of release dry-run on release/* branches Related: ENG-4821 (CI stage refactor), ENG-5102 (dep telemetry pipeline). Rationale and tradeoffs: The telemetry collector intentionally sends minimal metadata to avoid storing manifests; we accept a small increase in CI runtime (dep-telemetry job is background and cached) in exchange for faster triage of dep-related flakes. Migration notes: - Maintainers should read docs/ops/dep-telemetry.md for how to query events - To opt a repo out of dep-gatekeeper, add label ci/skip-dep-gate in repo settings or PR body.

release_notes:
- Reorganized CI into modular stage manifests for faster feedback.
- Added language-specific lint/test profiles to reduce duplication.
- Introduced dependency telemetry (minimal metadata) to help correlate dependency changes with flaky tests.
- Added dep-gatekeeper presubmit to flag large or risky dependency updates (opt-out via 'ci/skip-dep-gate').
- Decoupled release hooks and added a release dry-run smoke job to reduce accidental publishes.
